Help me go live on the StreamHub app "live". Follow this runbook with the streamhub tools:

1. Verify the app exists with get_app (name: "live"); if it does not, ask me before creating it with create_app.
2. Create an RTMP ingest with create_ingress (app: "live", inputType: "rtmp").
3. Give me the returned rtmp_url and stream_key formatted for OBS: Settings > Stream > Service "Custom", Server = rtmp_url, Stream Key = stream_key.
4. After I start streaming, confirm it is on air with list_ingress (status should be "publishing") and list_streams (app: "live").
5. Share playback: the public player is https://media.example.com/play/live/<room> (if the app has publicPlayback disabled, mint a signed URL with sign_playback_url). For embedding use https://media.example.com/embed/live/<room>.
6. Ask me if I want to record: if yes, use start_recording (roomName = the ingress room) and tell me the recording id so we can stop it later.

1. Verify the app exists with get_app (name: "live"); if it does not, ask me before creating it with create_app.

3. Give me the returned rtmp_url and stream_key formatted for OBS: Settings > Stream > Service "Custom", Server = rtmp_url, Stream Key = stream_key.
4. After I start streaming, confirm it is on air with list_ingress (status should be "publishing") and list_streams (app: "live").
5. Share playback: the public player is https://media.example.com/play/live/lobby (if the app has publicPlayback disabled, mint a signed URL with sign_playback_url). For embedding use https://media.example.com/embed/live/lobby.
6. Ask me if I want to record: if yes, use start_recording (roomName = the ingress room) and tell me the recording id so we can stop it later.

A stream in StreamHub app "live" is not working. Diagnose it with the streamhub tools:

1. get_health — is the server itself up?
2. list_ingress (app: "live") — check status (inactive/buffering/publishing/error), bitrate and dimensions. "inactive" means the encoder never connected: re-check rtmp_url + stream_key.
3. list_streams and list_rooms (app: "live") — is the room live, are there participants?
4. get_app_stats (app: "live") — viewers, ingress and the 24h log rollup.
5. query_logs (app: "live", level: "error", limit: 50) — recent errors around ingest/egress.
6. Summarize the root cause and the fix; typical culprits: wrong stream key, encoder pushing to the wrong host/port (RTMP is 1935 on the server IP, not behind the proxy), app recording/transcoding misconfig, or the room name not matching the app prefix.
